drafted.claim: A cluster in the left inferior frontal gyrus showed the same insula-seed connectivity effect as the right IFG (highest for Risky-self / Safe-both choices) but did not survive correction for multiple comparisons (p uncorrected = 0.001, T = 4.08, 38 voxels).
drafted.why: The tree records the surviving right-IFG insula-connectivity cluster (connectivity-between-left-anterior-insula) but nowhere the parallel left-IFG cluster with the same effect that fell below the correction threshold.

drafted.claim: In the decision phase, the Risky−Safe response difference between Social and Solo conditions yielded significant per-ROI linear-mixed-model coefficients in left ventral striatum, mPFC, precuneus and left TPJ (Appendix 1—table 5).
drafted.why: The tree carries the summary that only precuneus and TPJ showed positive Risky−Safe differences, but this appendix table is the only place the per-ROI Social-vs-Solo coefficients themselves are reported.

drafted.claim: In the decision phase, the Risky−Safe response difference between Social and Partner conditions yielded significant per-ROI linear-mixed-model coefficients in left ventral striatum, mPFC, precuneus and left TPJ (Appendix 1—table 6).
drafted.why: As with the Social-vs-Solo comparison, this appendix table is the only place the per-ROI Social-vs-Partner decision-phase coefficients are reported, beyond the precuneus/TPJ summary.

drafted.claim: The right middle temporal cortex responded more to low lottery outcomes for the partner in the Social than the Partner condition (Appendix 1—table 9), alongside the insulae.
drafted.why: The tree records the insula guilt response but no claim carries the right middle-temporal region that met the same Social>Partner low-outcome criterion.

drafted.claim: The right middle temporal cortex showed a larger low-minus-high lottery-outcome response difference in the Social than the Partner condition (Appendix 1—table 10).
drafted.why: The low-minus-high guilt contrast is claimed for the insulae but not for the right middle-temporal cortex, which this table row is the only place to report.
